localChanges: `generate-changelog.mjs` writes `changelog/<sha>.json` for each commit it turns into an entry, alongside `changelog/releases.json`, and both are tracked — 2233b2e is the shape. Today's two release commits staged only `releases.json`, leaving five behind.
No effect on the site: `releases.json` is what the bundle imports, and it was committed and deployed correctly both times. These are the per-commit records the generator reads back.
